name: ferro-kiuwan-report-analysis-task
description: Generates a vulnerabilities and code quality report (Markdown + HTML) from the latest Kiuwan analysis of an application, using the Kiuwan REST API. The Markdown report is added to the build summary and the HTML report is published as a build artifact and shown in the 'Kiuwan Report' build results tab. This task uses the proxy defined in the Azure DevOps agent (if any).
author: Ferrovial
